name: 06830 · Greenwich, CT
findings: ZIP 06830 (Greenwich) has 350 nonprofit organizations. 128 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 102 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06830 (Greenwich) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06830 (Greenwich) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).
